name: Seitokai Jiken Roku
source:
Various strange phenomena have occurred on campus, and you have come to solve solve the ghostly matter first-hand. 

This is a campus fantasy horror novel game. Advance by choosing paths in the readalong story. Contents suitable for both male and female audiences.
